titleEn: Ecorobotix Launches 10 New Plant Detection Models
titleZh: Ecorobotix发布10款新型植物检测模型，超精准喷洒覆盖120+作物
summaryZh: 瑞士农业机器人公司Ecorobotix宣布2027年植物检测模型阵容，新增大蒜、韭葱、马铃薯等10款商用模型，并免费开放55款测试模型（含辣椒、西葫芦、黄莎草等）。其ARA超精准喷洒器已在全球20多国处理超1.1万公顷，平均投入减少86%。尤其针对全球恶性杂草黄莎草，推出首个精准喷洒非选择性除草剂的解决方案，标志着超精准植保从大田向高价值果蔬扩展。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了AI植物检测与超精准喷洒技术从大田作物向蔬菜等多元场景的快速扩展，其86%的投入减少和针对恶性杂草的突破性算法，对智慧农业及畜牧相关种植环节（饲料作物、牧场管理）具有重要借鉴意义。
contentFull:
By Ecorobotix 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 Ecorobotix announces its 2027 plant detection model lineup: from March, growers will have access to 10 new commercial models, including garlic, leek and potato, and can test 55 upcoming models for free, such as pepper, zucchini and yellow nutsedge. ARA™ now offers more than 120 recognition and treatment models.

 The 2027 plant detection model lineup brings 10 new commercial models to the ARA ultra-high precision sprayer, with 55 upcoming models free for growers to test.

 In 2026 alone, Ecorobotix together with its customers tested the crop models that have now reached commercial status on more than 11,000 hectares in over 20 countries, with an average input reduction of 86% compared with broadcast spraying. The reliability that these models have shown over many different contexts now enables Ultra-High Precision crop care in contexts that previously only relied on broadcast spraying. Weeds can now be treated with minimal impact on soil while maximizing crop health.

 Rising Up to the Challenge of Yellow Nutsedge

 Yellow nutsedge is one of the most invasive and difficult-to-control weeds worldwide. Agroscope research has shown that yellow nutsedge caused yield losses of 40% to 71% in sugar beet and potato fields in Switzerland, highlighting the need for effective control measures. However, in addition to being highly invasive, it is difficult to eradicate, as common weed control methods, including selective herbicides, are often unsuccessful or unavailable.

 “Yellow Nutsedge is an increasingly common problem across Europe, spreading rapidly in countries such as Germany, the Netherlands, and Switzerland, while already being well established in southern countries like France, Italy, and Spain,” says Simon Gasser, Agronomist and Crop Algorithm Product Manager at Ecorobotix. “With the development of this new algorithm, we are offering the first precision spraying solution capable of detecting Yellow Nutsedge and applying a non-selective herbicide directly to the weed without damaging the crop.”

 This innovation reflects the company’s commitment to providing farmers with solutions that address current challenges in the field. As an upcoming model, it will be available for free to ARA users in March, as are all our upcoming models.

 Ultra-High Precision Weed Control in Potatoes Now Possible

 The potato model, commercially available and accessible to growers in March, is one example of how Ecorobotix tests the effectiveness of its models. During development, Ecorobotix compared ARA’s weed control efficacy using the potato model with conventional broadcast spraying (Figure 1). The results demonstrated that the algorithm successfully controls common weeds present in potato crop context.

 While trials like these provide valuable data, users’ feedback plays an equally important role in the development process. Luc Détroz, potato grower in Belgium, used the ARA™ potato model to control weeds across 300 hectares of potatoes on his farm.

 Weed Control Efficacy 20 days after treatment. Source: Trial conducted in Switzerland. Treatment stage of potato crop 10 cm high.

 “This clearly saved the crop. In a single pass, we were able to control goosefoot and knotweed, and the field remained weed-free until the end,” says Luc. “Without this treatment, the goosefoot would have become overgrown and woody, which would have been very difficult to manage.”

 ARA, a Well-Appreciated Partner to Growers

 The 2027 crop model lineup continues the company’s mission in providing farmers with tools to address both current and emerging weed management challenges. The more than 1,000 ARAs in use worldwide and more than 600,000 hectares treated to date show the confidence our growers have in our algorithms to deliver Ultra-High Precision crop care.

 Meanwhile the current carrot model has proved its worth among growers. The number of hectares treated by this award-winning model increased by more than 80%, while proving a concrete solution against the loss of metribuzin.

translationZh:
Ecorobotix宣布其2027年植物检测模型阵容：从3月起，种植者将可使用10款新的商用模型，包括大蒜、韭葱和马铃薯，并可免费测试55款即将推出的模型，如辣椒、西葫芦和黄莎草。ARA™现已提供超过120款识别与处理模型。

2027年植物检测模型阵容为ARA超精准喷洒器带来10款新的商用模型，另有55款即将推出的模型供种植者免费测试。

仅在2026年，Ecorobotix与其客户就在超过20个国家的逾11,000公顷土地上测试了现已达到商用状态的作物模型，与广播喷洒相比平均投入减少86%。这些模型在多种不同场景中展现的可靠性，使得超精准作物护理得以应用于此前仅依赖广播喷洒的场景。如今可对杂草进行处理，对土壤影响最小化，同时最大化作物健康。

**迎战黄莎草**

黄莎草是全球最具入侵性且最难控制的杂草之一。Agroscope研究表明，黄莎草在瑞士甜菜和马铃薯田造成40%至71%的产量损失，凸显了有效控制措施的必要性。然而，除了高度入侵性外，它难以根除，因为包括选择性除草剂在内的常见杂草控制方法往往无效或不可用。

“黄莎草在欧洲日益成为普遍问题，在德国、荷兰和瑞士等国迅速蔓延，而在法国、意大利和西班牙等南部国家早已扎根，”Ecorobotix农艺师兼作物算法产品经理Simon Gasser表示。“通过开发这一新算法，我们提供了首个能够检测黄莎草并将非选择性除草剂直接施用于杂草而不伤害作物的精准喷洒解决方案。”

**马铃薯超精准杂草控制成为可能**

马铃薯模型已商用，种植者可从3月起使用，这是Ecorobotix测试其模型有效性的一个示例。在开发过程中，Ecorobotix使用马铃薯模型将ARA的杂草控制效果与常规广播喷洒进行了比较（图1）。结果表明，该算法成功控制了马铃薯作物场景中常见的杂草。

虽然此类试验提供了宝贵数据，但用户反馈在开发过程中同样重要。比利时马铃薯种植者Luc Détroz在其农场300公顷马铃薯上使用了ARA™马铃薯模型来控制杂草。

“这显然挽救了作物。一次作业中，我们就能控制藜和蓼，且田块直到收获都保持无草，”Luc说。“如果不进行此处理，藜会变得木质化且过度生长，将非常难以管理。”

**ARA，种植者信赖的伙伴**

2027年作物模型阵容延续了公司的使命，为农民提供应对当前和新兴杂草管理挑战的工具。全球使用的1000多台ARA和迄今处理的逾60万公顷土地，显示了种植者对我们的算法提供超精准作物护理的信心。

与此同时，当前的胡萝卜模型已在种植者中证明其价值。这一获奖模型处理的公顷数增加了80%以上，同时为二甲戊灵（metribuzin）的损失提供了具体解决方案。
